Ethan: Noon check-in — cut window in ~2h. Train looks green but two cherrypick requests pending. Posting quick status and asks.

Priya: CP #3421 open (kv-cache race fix). Needs QA + owner review. @Samir can you take a look? :eyes:

Samir: On my queue, will review after this meeting. Heads up: integ test 'route-end-to-end' flaked locally, could block merge.

Taylor: CP #3423 (docs + minor lint) ready. No test changes. Can we fast-track that one? :thumbsup:

Ethan: @deploy-bot what's canary health rn?

deploy-bot: canary-check: OK — 95p latency 120ms, errors 0.02%, recent deploys stable.

Priya: QA env: seeing a routing regression that might be related to earlier CP #3405. Investigating correlation with kv change. If repro is confirmed, may require rollback.

Lucia: bumped cut window by 15m on calendar (gave tests a bit more time).

Samir: If QA repros tie to #3421, recommend we defer #3421 and only take #3423 in this cut. Also someone please add release labels to the docs PR.

Taylor: added label release/candidate and pinged @Ethan for final review.

Ethan: Doing final smoke now. If all green, target cut at 14:10 UTC. If QA flags persist we'll hold and triage. Call or ping me directly for emergency rollback.

Priya: noted, I'll keep monitoring QA and post updates here.

Samir: quick note — local repro steps: running the full routing suite with KV=enabled reproduces. Sharing stacktrace in PR comments.

Taylor: quick cherry-pick commands for reference:
```
git checkout -b cherry/3421
git cherry-pick abc1234
git push origin cherry/3421
```

deploy-bot: snapshot created: snap-2026-06-01-1215 for safety before cut.

Ethan: Thanks all — short list: (1) Samir to triage flaky test, (2) Priya to confirm QA, (3) Taylor to land #3423 if green. Update here when ready. :rocket:
